agent_executive_summary: 15-condo investment scan (5-7yr hold). Two Buys: Mi Casa (D23 3BR, $1.688M) — reliable 5.22% appreciation on 66 txns, 380m to CCK interchange, deep upgrader liquidity band, on frontier; and Commonwealth Towers (D03 1BR, $968k) — 220m to Queenstown MRT, 250-txn deep liquidity, ~5% below median entry in the One-North/GSW corridor. Three Avoids: Villa Marina (weak 2.38% appreciation + ~72yr lease decay on an oversized $2.0M 3BR), Sunnyvale Residences (3-txn near-untradeable boutique 4BR), and Amber House (top-of-market $3,240 PSF in a 105-unit boutique new launch). The rest are Neutral — generally fair-but-unremarkable: thin-data boutiques (E Maisons, The Amarelle, Melrose Ville, Crystal Heights), missing-data street-name/no-URA entries (Changi Road, Palm Grove), a top-quantum OCR new-launch 4BR (The Myst), a flat-appreciation GSW shoebox (Avenue South), and a dependable-but-baseline LRT 2BR (Hillsta).
agent_market_commentary: Mid-2026 SG market: ABSD/cooling measures keep the deepest liquidity in the sub-$1.0M and $1.8M-2.5M quantum bands, which is where this batch's best risk-adjusted entries (Mi Casa, Commonwealth Towers, Hillsta) sit. RCR/D03-05 corridors (One-North, GSW) and OCR upgrader towns with direct interchange access show the most resilient resale demand. New launches (The Myst, Amber House) carry developer-peak pricing and a multi-year capital lock to TOP ~2029, limiting near-term appreciation. Oversized older leasehold units (Villa Marina) face accelerating lease-decay drag and should be avoided for investment.
agent_methodology_notes: Rated each listing's stated unit type at its listed price/PSF for an investment hold. Appreciation rates from URA series with <30 txns (The Amarelle 12, Melrose Ville 8, Crystal Heights 3, Sunnyvale 3, Belvedere 25) were treated as indicative only and discounted toward district baselines. Four listings had no URA appreciation/txn data at all (E Maisons, Palm Grove, Changi Road, plus Amber House/The Myst which had median-only new-launch data) — for these, liquidity and value are unverified and confidence is set accordingly (low for the no-data resale entries). 'Changi Road' is a street-name project (no built_year), web-checked as small freehold walk-up stock near Kembangan. New-launch-bias flags (Avenue South, The Myst, Amber House) were respected — I did not override the adjusted rate with portal headline CAGRs. Two targeted web searches used (The Myst and Amber House pricing/identity; Changi Road identity). Remaining-lease for Villa Marina (~72yr) computed from 1999 TOP, not the scorer's generic 90 fallback. No own-stay rubric applied — all calls are investment-basis.
